proposal.hypothesis: With block size 256 and items_per_block 512, the launch may use fewer threads than output targets. A grid-stride target loop should let each thread own multiple outputs while preserving complete, unique coverage. This may reduce launch scheduling work, though the lower thread count could also reduce occupancy; no performance gain is assumed before controller measurements.

retained: Changed items_per_block from 256 to 512 while retaining block size 256 to test multiple outputs per thread if the launcher derives grid size from items_per_block.

Replaced single-target ownership with a grid-stride loop based on gridDim.x * blockDim.x, using a 64-bit index and an n-bound tail mask so arbitrary valid sizes have complete, non-overlapping output coverage.
